title: REQ · Store changes such as the secret door and inventory are pushed into the scene
summary: Every gameStore update reaches each SceneObject via sync
description: Context: BootScene.create subscribes to useGameStore and onStateChange calls sync on every SceneObject; SceneObject visibility derives from flag and hasItem conditions. Desired behavior: confirm this path and keep it intact. Expected result: opening the secret door (flag secret_door_open) or gaining an inventory item updates scene visibility. Why: store is the single source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: Given a created scene, when the store state gains flag secret_door_open true, then every SceneObject.sync is called with that state
Given a created scene, when the store inventory changes, then every SceneObject.sync is called with the new inventory
Given a null store state, when onStateChange runs, then no sync is called
technical_constraints: BootScene reads state only through useGameStore
definition_of_done: Store to scene sync confirmed and covered
